batches.analysis: The newly covered returned CANCELLED status triggers the existing experimental server grpc.canceled=true attribute. Extend the existing ExperimentalTestHelper with its conventional flag-gated value helper and assert that key only for the matching status and enabled flag. Keep the exact assertion and all new status cases.
batches.downsides: Adds one package-private test helper and couples the expected cancellation value to the interceptor's existing Status.CANCELLED equality condition. Local checks do not establish passing target CI.
batches.summary: Expect experimental cancellation telemetry in returned gRPC errors
batches.upsides: Addresses the common cause of seven failing test jobs and their aggregate gate while checking absence in default mode and for other statuses. Production behavior, semantic-convention expectations, and CI checks stay unchanged.

diagnoses.analysis: This is the dependent status gate, not an independent build failure. The frozen reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 fails it when common or test-latest-deps fails; both have the same new CANCELLED test assertion failure in this run. Repair the shared gRPC expectation, leaving the required gate intact.

The PR adds Status.CANCELLED to provideReturnedErrorArguments, but the exact server-span assertion omits grpc.canceled. All six failed invocations in this job report that unexpected key. TracingServerInterceptor already emits grpc.canceled=true for this returned status when experimental attributes are enabled. Add its flag-gated expectation to the shared test; retain exact attribute checking and all status cases. This applies equally to the baseline Java matrix and latest dependencies, without a runtime or CI configuration change.
evidence: GrpcTest > errorReturned(Status) > [15] Status{code=CANCELLED, description=null, cause=null} FAILED
